items.detail: Late addition to the report with an illness (downgraded midday); if he sits, Dominick Barlow and Jabari Walker are in line for bigger roles.
Listed for left hip injury management on the second night of a back-to-back (played 33 min Sunday at NYK); Pacers had not confirmed his status, decision expected near tip.
Expected to take on a heavy workload if Siakam (questionable, hip management, back-to-back) sits.
Questionable with bilateral low back tightness; reports say the Spurs could rest him with NBA Cup games Wednesday and Friday, which would be his first missed game of the season.
Questionable with a right shin contusion and named alongside Wembanyama as a possible rest candidate before the Portland and Lakers games; likely explains the model gap on his PRA Under.
With Dylan Harper out (third straight game) and backup PG Jordan McLaughlin questionable (shoulder), Castle is expected to get the bulk of point guard minutes; role goes up, more so if Fox sits.
Illness; sources conflict, with Athlon listing him Out while Fadeaway World and BVM list him Questionable; Bulls are also coming off a 151-145 OT loss Sunday.

In concussion protocol and hasn't played since Nov 18; Roundtable calls him probable and expected to start (moving Allen Graves to the bench) but Raptors Republic lists him questionable, so his status is unresolved.
Likely to move to the bench if Collin Murray-Boyles clears concussion protocol and starts, per Roundtable; Raptors Republic still projects Graves starting.
Brandon Ingram is off the injury report and makes his season debut, likely starting in Jones Jr.'s place; Jones projected around 20 minutes off the bench.
Brandon Ingram's season debut (likely starting) adds a primary creator beside Garland, a plausible reason for the model gap on his RA Under.

Rockets are fully healthy: Sengun was upgraded from questionable last game and Clint Capela returns after missing 10 games (ankle), adding frontcourt depth that may trim Sengun/Smith/Thompson minutes; plausible reason for the PRA/RA Under gaps.
Ziaire Williams is back in the Lakers rotation over LaRavia; Quentin Grimes expected to stay in the starting lineup with Reaves out.

note: Evening run ~5:10pm ET. Utah is on the 2nd leg of a back-to-back with Jaxson Hayes out (Mo Bamba likely at C). SGA was not on the 1:30pm report after missing Sunday. No new news found on open-bet Saddiq Bey or Best Bets props (Danny Wolf, Jaden McDaniels, Matas Buzelis, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Sidy Cissoko). Official starting lineups were not yet posted.
